### Unit: Numbers & Counting (`numbers-counting` - Pre-A1)

#### 🎵 Numbers & Counting 1 — _The Date Harvest Box_ (صندوق التمر اللذيذ)

- **Status**: `RECORDED`
- **Duration**: ~20.9s (48 words, 302 characters)
- **Vocabulary Covered (15/15)**: `one`, `two`, `three`, `four`, `five`, `six`, `seven`, `eight`, `nine`, `ten`, `eleven`, `twelve`, `thirteen`, `fourteen`, `fifteen`
- **Full Scenario Audio**: [`assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-1_full.mp3`](file:///C:/Users/AhmedMahdy/OneDrive - Advansys IS/Documents/Antigravity/WordPix/assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-1_full.mp3) (449.6 KB)
- **Dialogue Clips**: 5 synthesized files

**Script Dialogue:**

> **Tariq**: "Adam, Uncle Omar brought fresh dates. How many do we have for the guests?"
> **Adam**: "Let's count! One, two, three, four, five... wait, look here!"
> **Adam**: "Six, seven, eight, nine, ten!"
> **Omar**: "Splendid counting, Adam! Now add the ripe ones: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen."
> **Tariq**: "Exactly fifteen sweet dates. Beautiful work!"

#### 🎵 Numbers & Counting 2 — _The Heritage Coin Chest_ (صندوق العملات التراثية)

- **Status**: `RECORDED`
- **Duration**: ~27s (62 words, 398 characters)
- **Vocabulary Covered (15/15)**: `sixteen`, `seventeen`, `eighteen`, `nineteen`, `twenty`, `thirty`, `forty`, `fifty`, `sixty`, `seventy`, `eighty`, `ninety`, `hundred`, `thousand`, `million`
- **Full Scenario Audio**: [`assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-2_full.mp3`](file:///C:/Users/AhmedMahdy/OneDrive - Advansys IS/Documents/Antigravity/WordPix/assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-2_full.mp3) (475.7 KB)
- **Dialogue Clips**: 5 synthesized files

**Script Dialogue:**

> **Omar**: "Look at this heritage collection! In this silver tray, we have sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty ancient coins."
> **Adam**: "Twenty coins! Are there more in the wooden drawers?"
> **Tariq**: "Yes! They are bundled in sets of ten: thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety!"
> **Adam**: "That makes one hundred historic coins!"
> **Omar**: "Indeed! And centuries ago, a thousand merchants traded them across a million desert miles."

- **Full Scenario Audio**: [`assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-3_full.mp3`](file:///C:/Users/AhmedMahdy/OneDrive - Advansys IS/Documents/Antigravity/WordPix/assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-3_full.mp3) (429.6 KB)
- **Dialogue Clips**: 5 synthesized files

**Script Dialogue:**

> **Tariq**: "Ready for round one of our math quiz, Adam? Let's check the leaderboard."
> **Adam**: "I solved the first, second, third, fourth, and fifth questions correctly!"
> **Omar**: "Brilliant! Now rank your next answers: sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, and tenth."
> **Tariq**: "Perfect order. Now calculate the total score using addition and subtraction."
> **Adam**: "Through quick multiplication and division, the final score equals ten out of ten!"

#### 🎵 Numbers & Counting 4 — _Omar's Market Stall Deal_ (عرض متجر عمر)

- **Status**: `RECORDED`
- **Duration**: ~20.4s (47 words, 271 characters)
- **Vocabulary Covered (5/5)**: `plus`, `minus`, `times`, `divided-by`, `percentage`
- **Full Scenario Audio**: [`assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-4_full.mp3`](file:///C:/Users/AhmedMahdy/OneDrive - Advansys IS/Documents/Antigravity/WordPix/assets/audio/scenarios/numbers-counting/numbers-counting-4_full.mp3) (283.0 KB)
- **Dialogue Clips**: 4 synthesized files

**Script Dialogue:**

> **Adam**: "Uncle Omar, how much is this Arabic calligraphy set?"
